Weed in Harlem & Washington Heights

Harlem and Washington Heights share about 1,000 products across two active licensed dispensaries, with a third, Hibernica Central Park on 110th Street, listed but publishing no menu at our last pull. Gotham Buds on 125th Street is the largest at about 510 products, and Broadway Strains at 161st and Broadway is close behind at about 500. They sit three miles apart, so most people will use whichever is closer rather than compare them.

The combined menu is balanced: 281 pre-rolls, 242 flower listings, 231 edibles and 221 vapes, with only 15 concentrates, the thinnest dab selection of any neighborhood we track. Broadway Strains has the larger flower wall at 146 listings and Gotham Buds the deeper Jaunty and Grön runs. Prices start at $5.65 for 1906 sleep pouches and $10 for 5 Boro dime bags. For anyone north of 96th Street, these are the only licensed options before the Bronx, so they are busy stops for the whole upper Manhattan market.

Good to know
  • Two active shops: Gotham Buds on 125th Street (about 510 products) and Broadway Strains at 161st (about 500).
  • Hibernica Central Park on 110th Street is listed but had no menu published at our last pull.

Harlem & Washington Heights FAQ
Is there a dispensary in Washington Heights?

Yes, Broadway Strains at 3858 Broadway near 161st Street, with about 500 products and the largest flower selection north of Central Park. It is a short walk from the 1 train.

Which is better, Gotham Buds or Broadway Strains?

They are nearly the same size. Broadway Strains leans toward flower and carries 83 brands; Gotham Buds has deeper Jaunty, Grön and Cannabals runs. Choose by location: 125th Street versus 161st Street.

Why does Hibernica show zero products?

Our last menu pull returned no listings for Hibernica Central Park. That usually means the shop had not published an online menu or it was temporarily empty. Check the store directly before visiting.
